title: Draft: dfilter: Allow a literal as the LHS of an arithmetic expression
description:
Refactor the arithmetic semantic check.

Literal syntax nodes must be assigned a type during the semantic
check. Do that by naively re-checking the LHS after the RHS if we
cannot assign a type to the the LHS of an arithmetic expression,
instead of immediately throwing a syntax error.
